movie.title: Mystic Tales -The Spider Lady‘s Vendetta
movie.overview: The amnesiac paper craftsman Bai Xiaoman rescues Hu Bugui, a half-paper doll who is being hunted and has only three days to find the treasures needed to regain his human form. Bai Xiaoman decides to accompany him on an adventure to help him recover his lost memories. The two enter the Hidden Market using the Tiger Talisman to find the Rootless Water, where they encounter Meng Po (Meng Ruyi), trapped by a century-old obsession. They learn of her heartbreaking past, where she and her lover Lu Ming were separated by class barriers and could never be together again. Meng Po (Meng Ruyi) is consumed by her obsession and transforms into a spider demon, wreaking havoc. The two attempt to join forces with Lu Ming's reincarnation to redeem her, setting the stage for a fierce battle.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An amnesiac paper craftsman accompanies a hunted half-paper doll on a quest to retrieve magical artifacts, ultimately confronting a heartbreaking century-old tragedy that has transformed a legendary figure into a vengeful spider demon.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Bai Xiaoman, a paper craftsman suffering from amnesia, rescues Hu Bugui, a half-paper doll who has just three days to locate the treasures necessary to restore his human form. To aid in his quest and unravel her own lost past, Bai Xiaoman joins him on a journey into the mystical Hidden Market using the Tiger Talisman to seek Rootless Water. There, they encounter Meng Po (Meng Ruyi), whose century-old heartbreak and obsession with her lost lover Lu Ming have twisted her into a dangerous spider demon. Teaming up with Lu Ming's reincarnation, the duo must battle to redeem the vengeful spirit before her obsession destroys everything.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The story follows Bai Xiaoman, an amnesiac paper craftsman who rescues a mysterious half-paper doll named Hu Bugui. Hu Bugui is being hunted and faces a dire deadline: he has only three days to gather the essential treasures required to regain his full human form. Intrigued by the quest and hoping to recover her own lost memories along the way, Bai Xiaoman agrees to accompany him on his journey. Utilizing the powerful Tiger Talisman, the pair gains entry into the enigmatic Hidden Market to search for the elusive Rootless Water. During their investigation, they come face-to-face with Meng Po, also known as Meng Ruyi, who is trapped in a realm of tragic memories. They discover her painful history of being separated from her true love, Lu Ming, due to unyielding societal class barriers. Overwhelmed by grief and unable to move on, Meng Ruyi's century-old obsession transforms her into a terrifying spider demon that begins to wreak havoc. Realizing that redemption is her only peace, Bai Xiaoman and Hu Bugui track down Lu Ming's reincarnation to help appease her sorrow. Together, they unite to face the monster in a fierce and emotional final battle to break the curse of her lingering vendetta.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When an amnesiac paper craftsman named Bai Xiaoman saves a half-paper doll facing a three-day deadline to regain his humanity, the two embark on a dangerous journey into the realm of the Hidden Market. Armed with the Tiger Talisman, they seek the legendary Rootless Water to unlock their hidden pasts. However, their quest entangles them in a tragic, century-old mystery involving Meng Po and a devotion so intense it corrupted her into a vengeful spider demon, forcing the travelers into an epic clash between dark obsessions and the hope for redemption.
